infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NormOS reads your HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, steps, and active calories to personalize your daily workout recommendation and health insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NormOS does not write health data.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NormOS uses the microphone so you can talk to your chief of staff — ask questions and give voice commands.

plugins.cameraPermission: NormOS does not use the camera. This permission is required by the WebRTC library but is never triggered.
plugins.microphonePermission: NormOS uses the microphone so you can talk to your chief of staff — ask questions, give voice commands, and have a live conversation in Talk to NormOS.
